title: Connections in use against the limit, and who holds them
description: Facts about pg_stat_activity and the connection settings. The task's own backend is not counted. Counts by state, database and user cover client backends; byBackendType covers every backend.

omitted.description: Groups left out of items by maxItems

truncated.description: true when items was cut at maxItems

visibility.description: partial: the role is neither a superuser nor a member of pg_read_all_stats, so other roles' sessions show no state, query or wait event. The run reports permission_denied scoped to pg_stat_activity.

hiddenSessions.description: Rows of other roles' sessions that name a database and a role but whose backend type and state the role cannot read (0 when visibility is full). They are not in inUse; the count is an estimate (it can include a logical replication worker or walsender)

reservedConnections.description: reserved_connections (PostgreSQL 16 and later); null when the server has no such setting

usableConnections.description: maxConnections - superuserReservedConnections - reservedConnections: the slots an ordinary role can use

inUse.description: Client connections (rows whose backend_type is client backend), not counting the task's own. When visibility is partial only the sessions the role can see are counted: a lower bound, with hiddenSessions more that may exist

usedPercent.description: inUse as a percentage of usableConnections, one decimal; null when usableConnections is 0. A lower bound when visibility is partial (computed from the visible client backends only)

byState.description: Visible client sessions by pg_stat_activity.state; the hidden sessions of other roles are not counted here when visibility is partial (see hiddenSessions)

byBackendType.description: Every backend by backend_type, largest first; backendType is null for every row whose type the role cannot read (the sessions and background processes of other roles) when visibility is partial

byDatabase.description: Visible client sessions by database, largest first

byUserApplication.description: Visible client sessions by role and application_name, largest first

oldestIdleInTransactionMs.description: Time in ms the longest idle-in-transaction session (including aborted) has been idle; null when there is none or visibility is partial

oldestTransactionMs.description: Age in ms of the oldest open transaction of a client session; null when there is none or visibility is partial

waitingOnLock.description: Client sessions with wait_event_type Lock; null when visibility is partial
